 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Umesh Prasad, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Madan Kumar, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order

2 13-03-2024 Heard Mr. Umesh Prasad, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioner, who happens to be the husband of opposite party no.2, apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1197C of 2022, wherein cognizance has been taken for the offences under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with opposite party no.2 way back in the year 2018 and in fact the present complaint case has been instituted on account of certain differences, which Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.15212 of 2024(2)
dt.13-03-2024 he wants to patch up and is ready to keep his wife with all dignity and respect.

4. Considering the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner, let notice be issued to the opposite party no. 2, both under registered cover with A.D. as well as ordinary process, the requisites of which must be filed within a period of two weeks.
